walkthroughs.body_html:
This topic is part of the CCEA A-Level Biology specification.

Practical Skills in Biology appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet Practical Skills in Biology in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The CCEA board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Practical Skills in Biology.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
